The user asks about the SI unit of magnetic flux. Let me think about this.

Magnetic flux is defined as the product of magnetic field (B) and area (A) perpendicular to the field: Φ = B × A.

The SI unit of magnetic field (B) is tesla (T), and the SI unit of area is square meters (m²).

So the SI unit of magnetic flux is tesla·meter² (T·m²), which is given the special name "weber" (Wb).

The SI unit of magnetic flux is the weber (Wb).
